checkpoints.name: animagine-xl-4.0
checkpoints.note: Public HF repo, no auth strictly required, but the bootstrap script always sends the Authorization header when auth=huggingface.

checkpoints.name: pony-diffusion-v6-xl
checkpoints.note: LyliaEngine mirror of AstraliteHeart/pony-diffusion-v6-xl. The original AstraliteHeart repo 404s as of 2026-06; LyliaEngine is the maintained 200k-download mirror.

checkpoints.name: illumiyume-xl-v3.5
checkpoints.note: IllumiYume XL v3.5 (v-pred) -- 2026-05-08 release. v3.5 is v-pred; ComfyUI KSampler should use sampler_name='dpmpp_2m' scheduler='karras' denoise=1.0 cfg=7.0 (matches the SDXL convention). 307-redirects to B2 with a 15-min signed URL. The token is interpolated at download time from the CIVITAI_API_KEY env var.

checkpoints.name: netayume-v4
checkpoints.note: Lumina-Image-2 architecture (NOT SDXL). All-in-one safetensors (Gemma-2 text encoder + Lumina transformer + Flux VAE bundled). Works with standard CheckpointLoaderSimple in ComfyUI v0.18.2+. Use sampler_name='euler' scheduler='normal' cfg=4.0 steps=25. The previous AnonymousFinalBoss/NetaYume-v4-all-in-one repo is deleted (404) -- this duongve/NetaYume-Lumina-Image-2.0 is the canonical one as of 2026-06.

checkpoints.name: wai-illustrious-sdxl-v170
checkpoints.note: WAI's Illustrious SDXL v1.7.0 (2024-Q4 release). The predecessor lineage to the current Illustrious family -- same SDXL base, but earlier fine-tune with softer skin tones and less aggressive hand/face correction than v3.5. Reuses the SDXL sampler config: dpmpp_2m/karras, cfg=7, steps=30, 1024x1024. 307-redirects to B2 with a 15-min signed URL.

loras.name: illustrious-style-sdxl
loras.note: Optional Sadamoto Yoshiyuki XL LoRA. Only used by the Animagine template. Skip for the smoke test if volume is tight.
